title: English Practice Quiz 0875
description: A ten-question English practice quiz covering grammar, vocabulary and practical communication.

questions.question: In a spreadsheet, a cell is:
options: the intersection of a row and column
questions.explanation: A cell is formed where a row and column meet.

questions.question: Which file format is commonly used for a portable document?
questions.explanation: PDF is widely used to share documents consistently.

questions.question: A browser tab allows you to:
options: keep a separate page open in the same browser window
questions.explanation: Tabs let users open multiple pages in one browser window.

questions.question: Two-factor authentication adds:
questions.explanation: Two-factor authentication requires an additional proof of identity.

questions.question: A file stored in the cloud is generally saved:
questions.explanation: Cloud storage keeps files on remote servers accessible online.

questions.question: Which shortcut commonly copies selected text on Windows?
questions.explanation: Ctrl + C is the standard copy shortcut.

questions.question: A 'read-only' document can normally be:
questions.explanation: Read-only access prevents changes to the file.

questions.question: What does 'CC' in an email field mean?
questions.explanation: CC sends a visible copy to additional recipients.

questions.question: A software update is often installed to:
options: fix issues and improve security or features
questions.explanation: Updates commonly include bug fixes and security improvements.
